messages:
alice.k: Quick heads-up: change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Rolling plan is staggered-stitch: runtime v2.4 -> api v3.1 -> console 1.9 (pinned) -> router header mirror. Need sign-off on pin windows, autoscale cushion, and rollback triggers.
ben_dev: timeline looks good from API side. Question: do we pin console to 1.8 for initial waves or go straight to 1.9-rc?
carla_sre: prefer pinning console to 1.8 for waves 1-2, then unpin at wave 3 to avoid schema drift if runtime KV header layout changes.
dave_p: +1 pin. Runtime v2.4 changes batching; request autoscale cushion +30% for the first 2 waves.
runtime-oncall: we can push a temporary autoscale override for 3h starting at 22:00 UTC. Will monitor p95, tokens/s, and queue depth.
deploy-bot: queued: plan 'staggered-stitch-2026-03-21' by @alice.k. Waves: 1=runtime(10%), 2=api(25%), 3=console(unpin->100%), 4=router(mirror then route).
erin-m: Router header mirror requires feature-flag flip. Can we mirror in wave 3 but only enable routing after final green?
router-team: yes. We'll set mirror=true, route=false. After console unpin and stable API metrics, we'll flip route=true.
carla_sre: propose rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.8% over 5m OR p95 latency > +40% vs baseline OR user-facing error spike flagged by canary. If triggered, deploy-bot auto-hold + notify #eng-oncall.
alice.k: add manual abort: if console error rate > 0.5% at wave 3 -> immediate unpin and rollback runtime to v2.3.
ben_dev: I'll implement pin/unpin in orchestration: set `console_version=1.8` -> `1.9` at wave 3. Will include a single-line release note entry.
deploy-bot: executing preflight dry-run for wave 1: `/deploy run --plan staggered-stitch-2026-03-21 --wave 1 --dry-run`
runtime-oncall: found minor KV eviction in staging smoke. Adding warmup probe before traffic: `GET /_warmup?routes=kv` must return 200 <3s.
dave_p: warmup probe added to wave-1 hook.
erin-m: release notes updated: https://go/release-notes/staggered-stitch-2026-03-21 (console pin, rollback steps, autoscale override).
carla_sre: monitoring runbook refs: runtime-eviction-alert (pager), api-5xx-rate (pager), console-error-rate (pager). If any pager fires during a wave, deploy-bot pauses and requires `:deploy-ack` from SRE to continue.
alice.k: question: do we need a KV migration window?
erin-m: no migration this release, KV format compatible.
ben_dev: annotating orchestration doc with pin/unpin steps, autoscale override, and warmup probe.
deploy-bot: prep complete. Will post wave start/update messages. Final go/no-go check at 21:45 UTC. :thumbsup: 
carla_sre: I'll be on-call watching traces. dave_p watches router mirrors. runtime-oncall & router-team stay nearby 22:00-01:00 UTC.
alice.k: thanks all — see you at 21:45 for final sign-off.
